falsifier: A section through VB whose reduced components differ from the fiber of the source over VB; a section through V^a+ or V^a- other than one plane of section degree 2; a section that differs between the two primes; or containment equations that vanish on a plane outside the 7-plane.

scope.claim_boundary: Exact modulo 32009 and 32029 at the listed points m. The section is a necessary condition on a composed limit: the record does not compute which planes of a section are limits of the fibers over the middle stratum, and it samples the plane of B9 and the conic of V at six points each.
scope.statement: For a fixed point m of the fiber of a nullity-12 stratum at the shared N+ or N- basepoint, the limit planes of a nullity-8 source contained in the limiting 7-plane of m form the linear section of the source fiber V_+(K2) recorded here; a composed limit through that stratum lies in such a section.
